messages:
Ava (docs): quick heads-up — opened docs PR #4921 that updates the SDK migration guide and replaces the old embed example with the new streaming snippet. Please review when you have a sec.
Ben (platform): thanks Ava — I skimmed, looks good. CI/docs preview link?
docs-preview-bot: preview build failed for PR #4921 — failing check: docs-lint (broken link) — https://ci.example.com/builds/4921
Ava (docs): ugh I missed that link, will fix. also flagged an accidental real KMS ARN in the example (my bad). snippet below — needs redaction before merge:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(kms_key="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345")
resp = client.embed("hello")
```
Chris (sdk): yep that's a real key, we should redact. do we have a standard placeholder we prefer?
Ben (platform): replace with `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID` and add a short footnote about placeholders.
Sam (security): thanks for flagging @Ava. we need to run the sensitive-docs approval flow before merge — please open a redaction request and attach the PR. I'll triage within the next business day.
Maria (legal): FYI if the snippet touches customer-supplied keys we need a short paragraph about not pasting live credentials into docs / examples. I can draft language.
Ava (docs): opening the redaction request now and will update the example + add the legal blurb. can we still merge in the normal window (tomorrow morning) if approvals come back?
Sam (security): tentative yes, but we need sign-off from both security and legal. if either requests a hold we'll wait. please ping me once the redaction request is linked.
Chris (sdk): small ask — after redaction can someone run the preview locally? our CI container sometimes caches old builds and shows false broken-link errors.
Ben (platform): noted. I'll kick a fresh preview once the PR is updated.
Ava (docs): updated PR with placeholder and added Maria's blurb (draft). reopened preview: docs-preview-bot: preview succeeded for PR #4921 — https://ci.example.com/builds/4921/preview
Sam (security): reviewed the redaction request and placeholder. :thumbsup: I'm good with this wording, passing to Maria for legal wording confirm.
Maria (legal): read quick, small wording tweak suggested in the PR comments. nothing blocking.
Ava (docs): thanks all — merging after a 30-minute wait window to let ops/backports catch up. will tag the release notes. :tada:
Ben (platform): cheers. filing a follow-up to scrub other examples repo-wide next sprint.
docs-preview-bot: deploy notification: docs site updated for main (PR #4921) — live in ~5 minutes.
